meta.description: Conservative supplementary reading senses: explicit English definitions of Bengali words and independently attested short Bengali equivalents of English words. Equivalents from one source definition stay grouped. Context is retained in definition or definitionBn. Bengali prose is never machine translated. Community data can contain errors and uncommon senses; broad literary coverage is not a claim of completeness.
